description: Locally declared required-proof set for resident merge admission. HERMES must know which proofs are required rather than inferring them from whatever statusCheckRollup happens to return. Proof identity is (kind, workflowName, matchName) -- never the display name alone, because a different workflow or a status context sharing a name would otherwise be able to substitute for the real proof. Editing this file changes what merge admission means and is reviewed as such. A malformed entry fails closed rather than silently dropping a required proof.
